description: Check up to 100 IP addresses in one call for VPN, proxy, Tor exit, relay, hosting or CDN membership, using the VPN & Proxy Detection API's native batch endpoint. Requires a Starter or higher VPN & Proxy Detection plan. Rows carry the same fields as `vpn_proxy_detection` under the same plan rules: confidence, seen times and residential-proxy network names need Pro or higher, null below, and a residential-proxy network is named only where its exit is attributed. Rejected inputs, such as reserved addresses, come back as ok=false rows with an error code. Data is IPv4-first; IPv6 mostly returns unknown. Duplicates are looked up once. Costs 1 VPN & Proxy Detection API credit per IP successfully looked up; rejected rows are not charged. Use this whenever you have 2 or more IPs; split lists longer than 100 client-side.

ip_addresses.description: IP addresses to classify (max 100 per call; 1 credit per IP successfully looked up).

name: bulk_vpn_proxy_detection
